headline: Indian Rupee Faces Oil Price Test After Month-Long Rally
summary: The Indian rupee is expected to open flat after reaching a 2.6% monthly gain, facing pressure from rising oil prices while cushioned by foreign capital inflows.
why: As a major energy importer, India's currency and macroeconomic stability are highly sensitive to fluctuations in global crude oil prices and foreign portfolio flows.

impacts.name: Indian Rupee
impacts.why: Higher oil prices pressure import costs, countering positive capital inflows for the rupee.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Crude oil price increases offset the positive momentum from sustained foreign capital inflows, keeping the rupee flat.
